summary.text: Michaela Barnett, a Democratic engineer and small-business owner, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House in Tennessee's 2nd District to Tim Burchett.
She says she spent last year working in Congress, and she won the August 6, 2026 Democratic primary unopposed.

paragraphs.text: Michaela Barnett describes herself as a local small-business owner and an engineer who learned the value of hard work doing barn chores before and after school.
Ballotpedia likewise lists her career experience as working as a small business owner.
She says she spent last year working in Congress, where she concluded that “our government is not working for us.”
Barnett won the August 6, 2026 Democratic primary unopposed.
During the campaign, she described it as focused on cost of living, healthcare, and jobs in East Tennessee.
She received 41.2% of the vote to Tim Burchett's 57.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
